verdict.rationale: SolidJS is an open-source, client- and server-side UI rendering library that runs in the developer's own environment. It is not a hosted service that collects or holds user data, so an AI-training opt-out is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows SolidJS ingesting user data or shipping any data-use or training policy that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
